days.markdown:
- Arrive at SAN 2:27p via Alaska Airlines 035.
- Pick up RV near South Park.
    - [1304 38th St, San Diego, CA 92105](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cK7PttDtxoD5DKRU8)
- Refill water {{Open back doors, find hose in water tank box, screw on hose, fill tank, water indicator inside van.}} at Coronado boat station (and see **Coronado island!**)
    - [1845 Strand Way, Coronado, CA 92118](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LmtgXBnkBjKKCLe86)
- **Musita Abyssinian Bistro** for dinner (opens 5p). 🦔
- **Sunset at Sunset Cliffs!** Sunset is 7:59p. 🐸🦔
- Find overnight parking in Pacific Beach.
    - Near [Law & Dawes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Pd9zcfwNGtxGGfoT8). {{"Lots of vans camp along these roads. There is no parking on Thursday’s between 10pm and 1am for street sweeping."}}
    - TODO: Find 2-3 alternate spots in case we get knocks. Toward La Jolla. One paid.
- Go explore Pacific Beach boardwalk and get dinner.

- ~6:45a (9:45a ET): Wake up and start driving to [La Jolla tide pools](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JSYoot4S8YJVP5ko9). {{Leave ~7:15a. Park ~7:30a.}}
- ~7:45a: **La Jolla tide pools!** Low tide is 0.8 ft at 7:52a. 🐸
- TODO: Breakfast or brunch somewhere.
- **Shopping and Amazon locker pickups; otherwise free day.**
    - **Mitsuwa!~~~** 🐸
- Find overnight parking.
    - [Sorrento Valley Rd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/axG64dUDdZCa1ej59), North of Sorrento Valley Blvd. {{Pic of an actual RV there. Lots of space}}
    - TODO: Find 1-2 alternate spots heading to Del Mar / Solana Beach.

- ~7:15a (10:15a ET): Wake up and drive to [Del Mar Dog Beach](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4tf3Zim5ebwFBBm5A) 🐶. {{Leave ~7:45a. Park ~8a.}}
    - TODO: Scope out a good street in advance.
- ~8:15a: Del Mar Dog Beach, **maybe some tide pools, bluff walk** to Solana Beach! 🦔 {{Low tide is 1.2 ft at 8:29a and high tide is 4.8 ft at 3:38 PM so corridor is safe in the morning.}}
- ~9a: **Loaded Hash Burritos** @ Roberto's Tacos! 🦔
- Tour where Andrew used to live in Solana Beach. 🦔
- ~10:30a: Get back to RV and **start the drive!**
- Extreme and dangerous heat even at night in middle of desert. Stay at [Best Western Space Age Lodge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KWfqACLhk7uEiozs9) in Gila Bend, AZ. 4h16m++

- TODO: _Fill out this day! Wake up early to complete the ~2 hr drive to Tucson. Desert Museum, Signal Hill Petroglyphs, Gates Pass, Tucson Botanical Garden. Feel free to spend more time here, because we're aiming for White Sands at 4pm the next day, and there's nothing to do there if we get there too early. Do part of the drive to White Sands, and can attempt to sleep in RV but desert temperatures will probably be brutal, so another hotel night may be necessary._

- Complete the drive to White Sands!
- TODO: Lunch somewhere along the way.
- **White Sands dunes and sledding and sunset at the park!** 🐸🦔
- **First true dispersed camping night at Cloudcroft! Stargazing!** 🌠🐸🦔
    - [Forest Road 568, Cloudcroft, New Mexico 88317](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xs2ZkFAL2sYwE5Zn9) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/new-mexico/forest-road-568-dispersed-camping)). 43m++ {{"The road is rocky and narrow, but we were able to make it in a 2 wheel drive vehicle with pretty low clearance."}} {{Small town of Cloudcroft is nice last stop before going into forest.}} {{"Took a right at the fork (sweet group campsite there but occupied) and stayed the night at a pull off to the left, about halfway up the hill. Road is a little rough but flattens out as you go up the hill. After the fork, sites big enough for a van or larger Class B but that's it."}} {{"FR 568 is about a mile long and has a ton of all types of dispersed camping on both sides of the road, from little tent sites to pull-throughs for campervans and trailers."}}

- Wake up whenever and drive to Albuquerque. 3h28m++ {{Earlier the better if wanting to find campsite before dark.}} {{But if buffer day hasn't been used, can also take as much time as we want or end the day early and do Meow Wolf the next day, staying in Santa Fe.}}
- **Breaking Bad self-guided tour!** 🐸🦔
    - See [Abi's Map](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/2/edit?mid=1HCgGGtPsX4R2VSpXHL10pRdFA7hX118&usp=sharing) for filming locations.
- Assemble Breaking Bad photo costume and props; buy anything needed!
- Head to [First Cook Site](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wUsr8dgAzsUDKpgN8) to take the **Walter White photo!** 🐸 40m++
- Head to Santa Fe for **Meow Wolf** by 6pm! 🐸 (Closes 8pm.) 57m++
- Overnight at [Santa Fe BLM Dispersed Campsite](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MWXp8DMpQfkauiyLA) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/new-mexico/santa-fe-blm)). 16m++
    - **More stargazing!** 🌠🐸🦔

If we decide to take our time in ABQ:
- ABQ BioPark Botanic Garden (has orchids and aquariums!)

This is an optional day we built in as a buffer. As long as we didn't use the buffer day earlier, we can either stay in the ABQ / Santa Fe area an extra day and do the ~4.5 hr drive to Durango all at once on Sunday to pick up the rental car by 9pm, or, we could do about ~4 hrs of that drive early and camp out at [Turkey Springs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U5Di372jCxoZxLHEA) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/new-jack-road)), a cool, isolated spot for dispersed camping.

If we decide to take our time in ABQ-Santa Fe:
- Cafe Pasqual's for brunch.
- Casa Chimayo Restaurante.

- TODO: Depending on what we did the previous days and how early we start, we might have time here for half-day adventure somewhere in the area!
- Park the RV at [Bayfield-Durango Dispersed](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LihgcyMY3dyfPGSR8) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/blm-bayfiled-durango)). {{"Going east from Durango, you make a right turn on silver hills road. You will see the blm sign. Gravel road, fire pits."}}
- Uber to Durango Airport and pick up our rental car ~7pm but fine to be late, just call.
    - Confirmation #74406939. $73 pay at counter.
    - TODO: Save backup car services.

### Mesa Verde Day! 🐸🦔
- **No cell service at Mesa Verde!**
- 6:45a: Wake up and pack for day.
    - Don't forget!
        - Phones
        - IDs & Cards
        - Tickets
        - iPhone & Tripod & Power Bank & Cables
        - Food & Water
- 7:15a: Depart Bayfield-Durango Dispersed. 60m++
- 8:15a: Arrive at Visitor & Research Center.
- 8:30a: Depart from Visitor & Research Center.
- 10:00a: Arrive at Long House, 15m early for 10:15a briefing. {{"From the park entrance, drive 90 minutes/15 miles (24.1 km) to the turn for Wetherill Mesa (on your right, between the
Far View Lodge and the Far View Terrace). Drive 12 miles (19.3 km) to reach the Wetherill Mesa parking lot. Meet the
ranger at the trailhead to Long House, a 0.75 mile (1.2 km) walk from the parking lot. Allow 15-20 minutes to walk to the
trailhead. You MUST arrive 15 minutes early for a safety and logistics briefing.
Vehicles over 25 feet (8 m) and 8,000 lbs (3,628 kg) GVW are not allowed on the Wetherill Mesa Road. Allow at least 1.5
hours to drive to the Wetherill Mesa parking lot from the park entrance."}}
- 10:30a: **Long House!** 🐸🦔
    - ~12:25p-12:45p: Expected end.
- Drive to Cliff Palace. 40m++
- Lunch. (Maybe somewhere scenic on the Cliff Palace loop.)
- 2:30p: Meet at Cliff Palace Overlook for 2:45p briefing. {{"The tour starts 75 minutes from the park entrance at the Cliff Palace Overlook.
From the park entrance, drive 20 miles (32.2 km) to the all-way stop on Chapin Mesa. Turn left. Drive 0.4 miles (0.6 km)
and turn left onto the Cliff Palace Loop. Drive 1.7 miles (2.7 km) to the Cliff Palace parking lot.
To arrive on time, allow 75 minutes to drive to Cliff Palace from the park entrance. Meet the ranger at the Cliff Palace
Overlook, a 120 yard (110 meters) walk from the parking lot. You MUST arrive 15 minutes early for a safety and logistics
briefing."}}
- 3:00p: **Cliff Palace!** 🐸🦔
    - ~3:45p-4:30p: Expected end.
- Relax after! Free day. Other lookouts. Or go somewhere else or get back to the RV to shower and rest. Maybe go out for **dinner with the rental car before returning at Durango Airport by whatever time we started the reservation.**
